findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: browse_free_pool, preview_qr_encoding, get_credit_packs, buy_qr_outright · Private data: preview_qr_encoding, get_credit_packs, buy_qr_outright · Public sink: get_credit_packs · Destructive: get_qr_matrix, get_dither_qr_parameters, explain_qart.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: browse_free_pool, preview_qr_encoding, get_credit_packs, buy_qr_outright · Private data: preview_qr_encoding, get_credit_packs, buy_qr_outright · Public sink: get_credit_packs · Destructive: get_qr_matrix, get_dither_qr_parameters, explain_qart

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
